# Mosaic tile positions.
# NZ=393216 N=393216 DET_H=3072 DET_W=3072 n_z=143 n_x=70 NTHETA=589824 N_HALF=294912 OVERLAP=400
# 
# One row per tile — DIRECT placement only.  Mirror placement is
# derived: same z_center; x_center_mir = N - x_center; z-crops
# shared; x-crops swap under the h-flip.
# 
# step4_extract crops tile data from the DIRECT footprint in data.h5
# and fabricates a 360° tile scan (NTHETA frames): the first N_HALF
# are the direct crop; the second N_HALF are the mirror crop with an
# h-flip, per proj(θ, x) = proj(θ+π, N-1-x).
# 
# step6_stitch reduces back to a 180° big projection of shape
# (N_HALF, NZ, N):
#   for each output θ in [0, N_HALF):
#     place tile[θ]              at (z_center, x_center)      no flip
#     place tile[θ + N_HALF][:, :, ::-1] at (z_center, N - x_center)
# 
# Stored tile shape = (3072-crop_top-crop_bottom, 3072-crop_left-crop_right).
# In big projection, direct tile occupies:
#   rows [z_center - 3072/2 + crop_top,  z_center + 3072/2 - crop_bottom)
#   cols [x_center - 3072/2 + crop_left, x_center + 3072/2 - crop_right)
# 
# columns: z_tile x_tile z_center x_center crop_top crop_bottom crop_left crop_right
